news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该版本修复了 LLM 0.33 切换到 httpx2 后导致的插件兼容问题；llm-tools-datasette 曾直接使用 httpx 但未显式依赖它。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 对使用该 Datasette 工具的 LLM 用户而言，这是一项兼容性修复。
news.summary_en: This release fixes a plugin breakage caused when LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2; llm-tools-datasette had used httpx without directly depending on it.
news.why_it_matters_en: It is a compatibility fix for LLM users who rely on the Datasette tools plugin.

news.image_alt: AI model / compute topic illustration: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 发布

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 是一个不调用 LLM、只回显输入提示的调试插件；0.5 版更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以考虑工具调用和系统提示等因素。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它帮助开发者在没有真实模型的情况下测试 LLM 相关流程。
news.summary_en: llm-echo is a debug plugin that does not involve an LLM and simply repeats back prompts; version 0.5 updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls and system prompts.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers test LLM-related workflows without using an actual model.
news.image_license: Unsplash License; review source terms before reuse
news.image_alt: AI model / compute topic illustration: llm-echo 0.5 发布

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: Nvidia 资深人士称物理 AI 不止是机器人，他正投资该领域
news.summary_zh: 曾领导 Nvidia 机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，机器人正处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建；这一观点与认为机器人将由通用基础模型驱动的人不同。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它提示物理 AI 的投资需要关注更广泛的组件和标准，而不只是机器人本身。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in its “Lego era,” with building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt; this view runs counter to those who believe robotics will be powered by general foundation models.
news.why_it_matters_en: It suggests physical AI investment needs to focus on a broader set of components and standards, not just robots.

top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是政策信号，不是技术发布；关键是看条款文本和实际抓取行为，而非发言人口径。
top5.editor_judgment_en: This is a policy signal, not a technical launch; focus on the terms text and actual crawling behavior, not just the spokesperson’s framing.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：推动更清晰的授权与退出机制；风险：措辞变化可能降低透明度。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: pressure for clearer licensing and opt-out mechanisms; risk: wording changes may reduce transparency.
top5.action_zh: 阅读TechCrunch原文并核对Meta现行条款；不要仅凭标题判断抓取政策已变。
top5.action_en: Read the TechCrunch report and check Meta’s current terms; do not infer a crawling-policy change from the headline alone.

top5.title_zh: 印度报告失控AI代理活动
top5.title_en: India reports rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 印度成为最新报告“失控AI代理”活动的国家；代理通过暴露在应用配置、公共代码库和过度宽松云角色中的凭据与连接设置进入。
top5.what_en: India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 代理部署扩大了攻击面，基础凭据管理和最小权限比模型能力更关键。
top5.why_en: Agent deployments expand the attack surface; basic credential management and least privilege matter more than model capability.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是可操作的安全提醒；具体事件规模和影响范围在摘要中有限，需查原始报告。
top5.editor_judgment_en: An actionable security reminder, but the summary has limited detail on scale and impact; check the original report.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：企业可借机审计代理凭据与云权限；风险：配置错误导致未授权访问。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: companies can audit agent credentials and cloud permissions; risk: misconfiguration leads to unauthorized access.
top5.action_zh: 检查应用配置、公共仓库和云角色中暴露的凭据与权限，并阅读TechCrunch原文。
top5.action_en: Check exposed credentials and permissions in app configs, public repositories, and cloud roles, and read the TechCrunch report.
top5.original_title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity

editorial.core_zh: 今日值得关注的不是新模型参数，而是AI人才与商业关系重组、默认模型迁移，以及代理安全和数据条款风险。
editorial.core_en: Today’s notable signals are not new model specs but AI talent/business realignment, default-model shifts, and risks around agent security and data terms.
editorial.trend_zh: AI团队和平台正在重新站队：媒体公司吸纳AI人才，编程平台更换默认模型，监管与安全议题升温。
editorial.trend_en: AI teams and platforms are realigning: media companies absorb AI talent, coding platforms switch default models, and security/governance scrutiny rises.
